name: Revenant

source.note: Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual block (the one Curse of Strahd uses); the 2024 changes are not entered yet. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. The engine runs Regeneration's 10 Hit Points a turn but not its pause after Fire or Radiant damage; Rejuvenation, Turn Immunity, the vengeance damage and Vengeful Glare are text only (the engine has no sworn foe yet).

languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.summary: Regains 10 HP at the start of its turn unless it took Fire or Radiant damage since its last turn.
traits.text: The revenant regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If it took Fire or Radiant damage, this doesn't work at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn at 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.summary: If its body is destroyed, its soul takes another corpse within a day.
traits.text: When the revenant's body is destroyed, its soul lingers. After 24 hours the soul enters and animates another Humanoid corpse on the same plane and regains all its Hit Points. While the soul has no body, a Wish spell can send it on to the afterlife for good.

traits.name: Turn Immunity
traits.summary: Effects that turn Undead don't affect it.
traits.text: The revenant is immune to effects that turn Undead.

traits.name: Vengeful Tracker
traits.summary: Always knows the distance and direction to the one it hunts.
traits.text: The revenant knows how far away and in which direction the creature it has sworn vengeance on is, even on another plane, and it knows if that creature dies.

actions.name: Fist
actions.summary: Pounds a target; its sworn foe takes 14 (4d6) more, and it can grab instead of hitting.
actions.text: Melee attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The creature it has sworn vengeance on takes an extra 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the revenant can grapple a Large or smaller target (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Vengeful Glare
actions.summary: Its sworn foe within 30 ft makes a DC 15 Wis save or is Paralyzed, then Frightened.
actions.text: The revenant picks the creature it has sworn vengeance on, if it can see it within 30 feet. That creature makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Failure: it has the Paralyzed condition until the revenant damages it or until the end of the revenant's next turn. When the paralysis ends, it has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns (with Disadvantage while it can see the revenant) and ending the effect on a success.

summary: A dead knight risen for vengeance: heavy fists, a paralyzing glare for its foe, and wounds that close on their own.
